_description: Gate 6 regression fixture — Chase cites 'UL 9540' and 'ISO 99999' (hallucinated), alongside real standard 'IEC 62619'. UL 9540 DOES exist in design_standards (energy domain). ISO 99999 does NOT. Gate must report 1 hallucinated code and trigger FAIL.
_how_to_use: Feed project.citedCodes + resolvedRows + unresolvedCodes into gate6.check(). Assert result matches expected_check_result.

_database_reality.UL 9540: EXISTS in design_standards (standard_code='UL 9540', industry_domain='energy'). NOT hallucinated.
_database_reality.IEC 62619: EXISTS in design_standards (standard_code='IEC 62619', industry_domain='energy'). Legitimate cite.
_database_reality.ISO 99999: DOES NOT EXIST in design_standards. Hallucinated by Chase.

resolvedRows.standard_name: Secondary lithium cells and batteries for industrial applications — Safety requirements

expected_check_result.actual_pattern: 1 cited standard(s) not found in design_standards table: ISO 99999
expected_check_result.expected: 0 unresolved standards (all cited codes must resolve to a table row)

_domain_coverage_note: With only 2 resolved energy-domain standards (UL 9540 + IEC 62619), the domain coverage sub-check would also return WARN (<3 required). However, the existence check fires first and produces FAIL before the coverage check runs. The WARN path for domain coverage is tested separately by the domain_coverage_only fixture variant (see gate-6-hallucinated-standards.json notes section).
_implementation_notes: gate6.check() receives the pre-built Gate6Input directly — no DB call in the pure check function.
loadInput() does the Supabase query; this fixture simulates the data AFTER that query.
sampleCheckOutput(input) is the test-harness entry point — no DB required.
